assertions.assertion: Explains that DefaultAccessTokenRetriever is internal in v4 and cannot be inherited
assertions.rationale: It states directly that in v4 DefaultAccessTokenRetriever was made internal and can no longer be inherited.
It provides a full HeaderBasedTokenRetriever : IAccessTokenRetriever implementation of GetAccessToken.

assertions.assertion: Shows registration via WithAccessTokenRetriever<T>() on the remote API endpoint
Mentions AccessTokenResult and its implementations (BearerTokenResult, DPoPTokenResult, NoAccessTokenResult, or AccessTokenRetrievalError)
assertions.rationale: It lists AccessTokenResult and all four implementations and returns BearerTokenResult, NoAccessTokenResult, and AccessTokenRetrievalError in code.
